item.orefishfarm.ferrofin.desc: Iron-scaled, rusting red toward the tail
item.orefishfarm.gilded_carp.desc: Golden and fast, with a blunt square head
item.orefishfarm.zincray.desc: Armoured in zinc scutes. Feeds along the bottom
item.orefishfarm.cuprum_eel.desc: Hums with current. Loses copper teeth
item.orefishfarm.brass_bream.desc: Bred from a Cuprum Eel and a Zincray
tooltip.orefishfarm.power_fish: Power fish: makes FE in a power tank
tooltip.orefishfarm.power_fish_amount: Power fish: %s FE/t in a power tank
tooltip.orefishfarm.habitat_food: While eaten, any fish can live in a %s tank
tooltip.orefishfarm.habitat_kit: Use on a Fish Tank: makes the aquarium %s
tooltip.orefishfarm.dynamo_coil: Use on a Fish Tank: makes it a power tank (sneak-use with an empty hand to take it out)
gui.orefishfarm.protected: Habitat food is keeping visiting fish alive
gui.orefishfarm.kept_alive: Out of its habitat, kept alive by habitat food
gui.orefishfarm.wrong_habitat: Out of its habitat! Needs %s, or this tank's habitat food
gui.orefishfarm.wrong_habitat_short: ⚠ Wrong tank: needs its habitat or this tank's habitat food
jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_tank: A fish eats fish food and sheds its product. Tanks of the same habitat placed together join into one aquarium, up to 8x8x8. Kits change a tank: a Heating Coil or Void Lens changes its habitat (a water bucket changes it back), a Dynamo Coil makes it a power tank. With Breeding switched on, pairs sometimes breed; a baby needs a free fish slot.
jei.orefishfarm.info.dynamo_coil: Use on a Fish Tank to make the aquarium a power tank: power fish make FE while they eat. Sneak-use with an empty hand to take the coil back.
jei.orefishfarm.info.habitat_food: Fish food for one habitat. While it is being eaten, every fish in a tank of that habitat lives, wherever it comes from, so fish from different habitats can share a tank and breed. A tank eats it first when a visiting fish needs it.
jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_bone: Left by a fish that died outside its habitat. Crafts into bone meal.
item.orefishfarm.lava_rod.desc: Fishes in lava as well as water. Fireproof
item.orefishfarm.void_rod.desc: Cast off an edge over the open void (in the End) to fish the void
jei.orefishfarm.info.lava_rod: A rod that fishes lava as well as water. What it catches depends only on the liquid. Any rod in the #orefishfarm:lava_rods tag can do this.
jei.orefishfarm.info.void_rod: Cast off an edge where nothing is below, all the way down (the End, or any dimension in #orefishfarm:void_fishing). The bobber settles a few blocks down and fishes the void. Any rod in #orefishfarm:void_rods can do this.
message.orefishfarm.tank_full: No free fish slot in this aquarium
message.orefishfarm.needs_live_fish: Only live fish go in a tank: a fish in a bucket
jei.orefishfarm.info.fish_bucket: A live fish. Fish Tanks hold buckets of fish: use one on a tank, or put it in a fish slot. Catch fish alive by fishing with their habitat's bucket in your inventory (a water bucket for water fish, an empty bucket for void fish), or scoop a wild one with a water bucket. Any mob bucket works in a tank, from vanilla or other mods. A newborn stays in its tank (marked * until you look at it) until you scoop it out: click it holding its habitat's bucket (water bucket, lava bucket, or an empty bucket for void fish). A fish's stats and genes show once it is in a bucket.
tooltip.orefishfarm.newborn: Newborn: scoop it out with its habitat's bucket
item.orefishfarm.squid_spinner.desc: Tackle. A flash of silver ore fish can't ignore
item.orefishfarm.shell_sinker.desc: Tackle. Sinks to where the rays rest
item.orefishfarm.puffloater.desc: Tackle. A grumpy float eels can't resist
item.orefishfarm.skim_pickle.desc: Tackle. Its glow draws up gilded carp
item.orefishfarm.tackle.how: Carry it near a rod in your inventory to clip it on, or hold it with a rod in your other hand and right-click
message.orefishfarm.tackle_replaced: Your %s broke; clipped on a spare
